name: smwsprites-adventure-island-coyote
title: Adventure Island - Coyote
description:
A coyote from Adventure Island. A flower is spawned in its place, and if player goes far enough past it, Coyote will spawn and try to catch up to the player. The color of the flower dictates what kind of coyote it'll be (Red - regular, Blue - jumps over hazards, Yellow - chases player, Green - very fast).

A standalone version is also included.

Requested by Blizzard Buffalo.
